1.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
1.description: The final rank of Improved Corruption allows your Corruption spell to benefit from spell haste. Improved Corruption is now a 3-point talent and increases the damage of Corruption by 3/6/9% (from 2/4/6/8/10%).

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Pandemic no longer grants Corruption the ability to benefit from spell haste (it still gives it the ability to critically hit).

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Blazing Speed now reduces the cooldown of your Combustion by 5/10/15 seconds.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Capstone: The final rank of Blazing Speed now gives you a 100% chance when taking damage while being below 35% health to increase your movement speed by 50% and dispel all movement impairing effects. This effect lasts 4 seconds and can only occur every 30 seconds.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Master of Elements now reduces the mana cost of Fire spells by 4/8/12%.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Capstone: The final rank of Master of Elements makes your Mage spell criticals refund 30% of their base mana cost.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Meditation now allows 8/16/24% of your mana regen to continue while casting, down from 17/33/50%.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Capstone: The final rank of Meditation makes each of your non-critical heals grant you a stack of Meditation, increasing your critical chance with healing spells by 2%. When you critically heal, this effect is consumed.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Capstone: The final rank of Trauma now makes you Rend benefit from melee haste.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Capstone: The final rank of Natural Perfection makes you gain the Natural Perfection effect whenever you take a critical hit, reducing all damage taken by 2%. This effect stacks up to 3 times and lasts for 8 sec.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Capstone: The final rank of Focused Will makes you gain the Focused Will effect whenever you take a critical hit, increasing healing effects on you by 3%. This effect stacks up to 3 times and lasts for 8 sec.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Honor Among Thieves now increases your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 1/2/3%.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Capstone: The final rank of Honor Among Thieves grants you a combo point whenever you deal damage to your target. This effect cannot occur more than once every 2 seconds.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Nether Protection now reduces periodic spell damage taken by 2/4/6%.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Capstone: The final rank of Nether Protection gives you a 20% chance after being hit with a spell or taking periodic spell damage to gain Nether Protection, reducing all damage taken by that school by 15% for 8 seconds.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Capstone: The final rank of Empowered Renew makes your Renew instantly heal the target for 15% of the total periodic effect.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Capstone: The final rank of Cruelty now allows your Rend to critically hit.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Capstone: The final rank of Arctic Winds makes your Deep Freeze casts apply to all enemies within 8 yards of your target.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Capstone: The final rank of Nature's Bounty now makes the heal over time effect of Regrowth benefit from spell haste.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Ignite now deals 10% reduced damage in PvP.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Fire Blast now deals 15% reduced damage in PvP, from 10%.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Exorcism now deals 35% reduced damage in PvP, from 30%.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Hammer of Wrath now deals 30% reduced damage in PvP, from 25%.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Mangle (Cat) now deals 10% reduced damage in PvP, from 15%.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Counterattack now deals 5% reduced damage in PvP, from 10%.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Mongoose bite now deals 10% reduced damage in PvP, from 15%.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Insect Swarm now deals 20% less damage in PvP, from 15%.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Fixed an issue where Slice and Dice could cause players to leave combat.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: The tooltip of Turn the Tables has been corrected.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: The tooltip of Serendipity has been corrected.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Aimed Shot rank 2 and above now deals additional static damage. Rank 2, 10. Rank 3, 20. Rank 4, 30. Rank 5, 40. Rank 6, 60.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Multi-Shot rank 2 and above now deals additional static damage. Rank 2, 10. Rank 3, 20. Rank 4, 30, Rank 5, 40..

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Inner Focus has been reworked. It now empowers your next Greater Heal, Mind Blast or Power Word: Shield, reducing its mana cost by 100% and granting it an additional effect. The cast time of your next Greater Heal is reduced by -50% and the critical strike chance is increased by 25%. Your next Mind Blast slows the target by -70% for 5 sec. The duration of your next Weakened Soul is reduced by 10 sec.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: The Fiery Payback disarm effect now lasts for 4 seconds, from 6, and now has a 10 second internal cooldown.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Storm, Earth and Fire now roots the target for 3 seconds, down from 4.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: The Felguard ability Intercept now applies an immobilize effect instead of a stun.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Frozen Power now shares diminishing returns with controlled roots (such as Frost Nova and Entangling Roots).

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Improved Insect Swarm now also increases the damage of Insect Swarm by 3/6/9%.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Insect Swarm scaling and base damage has been reduced by approximately 10%.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Righteous Vengeance now also triggers from Exorcism and Hammer of the Righteous.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Improved Defensive Stance now reduces spell damage taken by 2/4%, from 3/6%.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Deflection now gives 3/6/9% dmg reduction while Ghostly Strike is active, but no longer increases expertise.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Tactical Mastery no longer reduces damage taken.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Frost Channeling now reduces the mana cost of Frost spells by 4/8/12% instead of reducing the mana cost of all mage spells by 2/4/6%. The threat reduction has also been increased to 5/10/15% from 4/8/12%.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: The cooldown of Dragon's Breath has been increased to 25 seconds, from 20.

1.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
1.description: Balance of Power now reduces magic damage taken by 1/2%, from 3/6%.

7.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
7.description: The proc rate of Sudden Death has been reduced by approximately 20% for all ranks.

7.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
7.description: Mace Specialization has been renamed to Heavy Impact.

7.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
7.description: Urgent Touch now reduces the cast time of Healing Touch by 0.16/0.17/0.18/0.19/0.2 seconds and reduces its benefit from bonus healing effects by 20%.

7.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
7.description: Blood Drinker now consumes your Taste for Blood to instantly heal you for a small amount (increased by Attack Power).

5.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
5.description: The Earthfury 8 piece set bonus now makes Healing Wave jump to only one extra target.

5.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
5.description: Staves now increase your spell damage and healing done by 7%. Previously they increased spell damage by 6% and healing by 4%.

5.author: Nerf(287281026827550720)
5.description: Off-hand frills now increase your spell damage and healing done by 5%. Previously they increased spell damage by 4% and healing by 2%.
